title: [29.x]-Not enough inventory available at vendor location for this order
summary: Subcontracting receipt posting no longer duplicates component consumption by suppressing automatic flushing for India Localization output lines that already have consumption posted via Delivery Challan.
key_points: Component consumption was being posted twice during subcontracting receipt in India Localization
The standard manufacturing flow and India Localization processes now coordinate to avoid duplicate flushing
Subcontracting Order No is tracked on output journal lines to identify when to suppress automatic flushing
Item tracking, capacity posting, and normal production flushing remain unaffected
quote: Component consumption was posted twice for components using the Backward flushing method.
